messages:
deploy-bot: Packaging job finished for release v2.8.1-private-2026. Bundle ID rlw-20260320-7f3a. Artifact SHA256: 9a1f3b5c4e2d7a8b2c3d4f5e6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5

emily: ok team, prepping for quiet cutover window 02:00-04:00 UTC. I'll start transport prep and sign manifest. @jamie can you confirm mirror handoff order? :hourglass: 

jamie: holding on actual transport. Preflight check failed on staging mirror verify, remote checksum != local. Putting hold on cutover until we validate.

emily: hm, I just pulled remote checksum, looks different. local: `9a1f3b...4a5` remote: `6b7c2d...0f8`. re-running local sha to be sure.

jamie: paste output from verify script please (copy of the command we run):
```
sha256sum rlw-20260320-7f3a.tar.gz
# expected: 9a1f3b5c4e2d7a8b2c3d4f5e6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5  rlw-20260320-7f3a.tar.gz
# remote: 6b7c2d9f0a1b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8  rlw-20260320-7f3a.tar.gz
```

emily: re-run shows local still `9a1f3b...4a5`. I did an incremental repack earlier today; maybe the offsite mirror got a stale push. I did use the staging pusher.

security-bot: KMS-sign check: last key rotation for signing-key-01 at 2401100000. Cosign verification against that key shows signature does NOT match artifact ID for remote checksum. Suggest verifying with `cosign verify` and checking signer identity.

linda: I'm on KMS. I confirm rotation happened yesterday morning during the key-roll maintenance. Any artifacts signed before rotation will fail verify unless re-signed with the new key. If emily repacked with the rotated key, that could explain mismatch.

sahil: ok, given checksum + signature mismatch, we need a safe decision: either (A) proceed with cutover and risk inconsistent artifact for customers, or (B) abort window, pin current live v2.8.0 on mirrors, repack and re-sign, then re-run canary. My vote: B. Ops, what's the impact?

jamie: +1 B. We'll run a quiet revert back to pinned v2.8.0 on customer-facing mirrors now and cancel the 02:00 outbound transport. I'll run the mirror revert script:
```
# mirror revert snippet (ops)
./mirrorctl promote --mirror production-east --artifact v2.8.0 --force --reason "packaging checksum mismatch"
./mirrorctl verify --mirror production-east --artifact v2.8.0
```

maya: for CS impact: we have two customers scheduled for 02:30 window. If we abort now and keep v2.8.0 pinned, they should be unaffected, but we need to update their maintenance email. I'll send a one-line update once decision is official.

emily: fine, aborting cutover. I'll stop transports and start an expedited repack+re-sign to create v2.8.1-repack1 with deterministic metadata. ETA ~45m. I'll publish new manifest and checksum when ready.

linda: I'll unlock KMS for emily and confirm the new signing key is used. Will also run `cosign verify` once you publish.

sahil: decision: abort quiet cutover. Action items: @emily repack & sign -> post new SHA; @jamie revert mirrors and confirm pin -> post verification; @linda confirm KMS signatures -> post verify output; @maya update customers; I'll update release notes and the release ticket INC-4521 with the revert and repack plan.

emily: starting repack now. pushing progress in thread.

jamie: mirror revert in progress on production-east and production-west, will post verify output.

security-bot: recommended checklist for repack: 1) deterministic tar metadata / timestamps, 2) cosign sign with current key, 3) push to staging mirror then verify, 4) run canary test suite.

emily: done repack and sign. New artifact: rlw-20260320-7f3a-repack1.tar.gz SHA256: a1b2c3d4e5f67890abcdef1234567890fedcba0987654321a1b2c3d4e5f67890

emily: published manifest v2.8.1-repack1 to staging. cosign verify output:
```
cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/signing-key-01 rlw-20260320-7f3a-repack1.tar.gz
Verified OK : subject: "artifact:rlw-20260320-7f3a-repack1"
```

jamie: staging verify green. I'll schedule a controlled canary to production-west in 30m then roll if green. Mirrors currently pinned to v2.8.0 as requested.

sahil: I'll update release notes: "v2.8.1: private build repacked and re-signed (v2.8.1-repack1). No code changes; packaging metadata corrected to ensure deterministic checksums. Cutover aborted for today; new canary at 03:00 UTC. See INC-4521 for timeline and artifacts."

maya: emailing impacted customers now with an ETA for canary and note that no user-facing changes expected.

emily: thanks all. posting final checksums and manifest link: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/rlw/20260320/rlw-20260320-7f3a-repack1.tar.gz.sha256

sahil: closing the thread for now. If any unexpected checksum or signature issues crop up during canary, we'll follow the rollback playbook pinned in #eng-releases. :white_check_mark:
